content: Standard Web Audio metronome/sequencer pattern (Chris Wilson 'A Tale of Two Clocks', cwilso/metronome): a setTimeout loop every ~25ms scans a ~100ms lookahead window and schedules any upcoming beat times on the AudioContext (sample-accurate), while setTimeout itself is never used to trigger sound directly. A separate requestAnimationFrame loop reads audioContext.currentTime and a queue of scheduled note times to drive UI (e.g. flashing the beat, moving a cursor) without touching the audio thread. This same scheduled-beat-time list is the natural 'expected timeline' to align performance events against.
